title: Tantive IV
description: Bail Organa as well as his daughter Leia both used the Tantive IV in their work for the Imperial Senate publicly. Secretly, however, they used the Alderaanian Corvette for missions to aid the Rebel Alliance in their quest to restore the Republic from the tyranny of the Empire. Leia was dispatched aboard the Tantive IV by Bail to retrieve Obi-Wan Kenobi to join the fight. However, she found herself at the battle of Scarif, intercepting the plans to the Death Star and then captured by Darth Vader before being able to complete her mission.
